description:
Pre-battle Deployment Orders is a vanilla-balance friendly QoL mod.

Download Pre-battle Deployment Orders 1.2.2
No dependencies

Press O to open the menu in Fleet or Refit screen, or click the top-left Orders button in Fleet screen.

Screenshots

Features

Assign a lead ship and assign escorts to it. You can assign escort groups to escort ships, logic loops are handled and prevented from selection
Assign a lead ship or unassigned ship to a flank
Flank ships automatically get a waypoint to midway point near their assigned edge, or a capture order if there is one in the area
Toggle default Search & Destroy order fleetwide to unassigned/lead ships
Clean, vanilla-friendly UI design. Nameable escort groups
Orders get assigned when ships are deployed, including reinforcements. No interference with player orders or changes during battle
Player is informed of ships gone missing
No AI changes
Preset management

No compatibility issues that I am aware of. Safe to install and remove* mid-save.

* there will be some left over code classes and junk, but save will remain functional

Changelog
1.2.2 - fixed menu opening while typing names in refit screen
1.2.1 - slightly expanded Flank role's capture point search radius
1.2.0 - added preset management submenu, added unobtrusive Orders button to Fleet screen, changed default keybind to 'O'

!AI DISCLAIMER!
